title: handleInputChange answers nothing for a chat weight, trusting useChatEdits' chatWeight to be its only reporter
evidence: widget-src/src/components/HealthTool.tsx:492 handleInputChange's condition (fromChat ? field !== 'weightKg' : ...) relies on useChatEdits' chatWeight (HealthTool.tsx:533, lead H53) being the only reporter of a chat weight. A future fromChat caller of handleInputChange('weightKg', ..., true) outside useChatEdits would silently answer nothing. Remedy: a one-line comment at that line naming chatWeight, next time the file is touched. Not done by the existing comment: HealthTool.tsx:490 already names chatWeight (PR 1388, ca698929b) but does not say chatWeight is the only fromChat reporter; the owner ruled 2026-11-13 that it is not the fix asked for
